description: Change of use and conversion of the rear parts of 308 and 310 Eastcote Lane from educational use to provide two self-contained one bedroom flats, comprising one flat within the rear part of No. 308 and one flat within the rear part of No. 310.
decision_conditions: <p><strong>Substandard Residential Accommodation</strong></p><p>1. The proposed development would provide two one-bedroom residential units that would fail to deliver satisfactory living conditions for future occupiers. In particular, the units would not meet the minimum internal space standards, provide inadequate outlook, and would result in a poor standard of residential accommodation. The proposal would therefore be detrimental to the residential amenities of future occupiers and is contrary to Policies S4(2)(c), DP3, HO7 and L2(d)(ii) of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026) and Policy D6 of the London Plan (2021).</p>

<ul><li><p><strong>Inadequate Housing Mix</strong></p><p>2. The proposed development would fail to provide an appropriate mix of housing, as it would not achieve the requirement for a minimum of 35% family-sized accommodation within the development. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy HO1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p></li></ul>

<p>3. In the absence of a legal agreement securing a car-free development, and insufficient evidence demonstrating that the surrounding highway network has adequate capacity to accommodate the parking demand generated by the development, the proposal would be likely to exacerbate on-street parking pressures within the surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies T3, TR4 and TR6 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policies D3 and T6.1 of the London Plan (2021), and Policies GR1, M1 and M2 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p><strong>Refuse Collection Arrangements</strong></p><p>4.The proposed refuse storage and collection arrangements are inadequate, as the carrying distance between the refuse storage area and the collection point on the public highway exceeds 20 metres. Consequently, the proposal would fail to provide a satisfactory refuse collection solution and is therefore contrary to Policy CE1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p><strong>Fire Safety</strong></p><p>5.The applicant has failed to demonstrate that the proposed development would achieve an appropriate standard of fire safety. In the absence of sufficient information to demonstrate compliance with the requirements of Policy D12 of the London Plan (2021), the proposal is contrary to Policy D12 of the London Plan (2021).</p>
